posting: Northwind Cloud announced on Tuesday that it will cut 8% of its workforce as it shifts spending toward AI products. The company, based in Seattle, said affected employees would receive 16 weeks of severance. Shares rose 3% in after-hours trading. Analysts said the move follows similar cuts at other software companies this year. A spokesperson declined to say which teams were affected.
